- Validate inputs: ensure a, b, c are positive numbers and satisfy triangle inequality (sum of any two sides > the third); return False otherwise.
- Identify the hypotenuse as the maximum side; assign the other two as legs. Work with squared lengths to avoid floating-point sqrt.
- Check Pythagorean condition: hypotenuse^2 == leg1^2 + leg2^2. For floats, compare with a small tolerance (e.g., abs(lhs - rhs) <= eps); return True if satisfied, else False.
